title: Creator of Heaven and Earth
speaker: Antwan Cronje
summary: We're in week 2 of our ABC series. In this series we're looking at the Apostles Creed to help guide us in what the church has believed for over 17 centuries. This week we look at God as the Creator.
quotes: Life here isn't lucky. It's set.
God is the only One who paints with no paint, and builds with no bricks.
Science answers when. The Creed answers Who.
